blocking_finding: Published T04 v2 angle columns are in RADIANS (project sign_offset_detector docstring: angles are radians). The runner compares raw values to limits written in degrees (L1_BOUNDS_DEG, L2_JUMP_DEG) with no conversion (grep for rad/convert in run_um21_q01_assessment.py finds none). So L1 and L2 could never fire; the reported 0 failures is not genuine. The 9 tests use degree-valued synthetic arrays only, so they did not catch it.
